title: Engagement Undermines Safety: How Stereotypes and Toxicity Shape Humor in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-generated joke punchlines and satirical headlines using a fine-tuned ALBERT-v2 stereotype classifier (trained on the Multi-Grain Stereotype dataset) and LLM-based ordinal classification (rating setups as Not, Subtle, or Strong Stereotypical) to measure the correlation between stereotypicality and perceived funniness.

Assessing the toxicity of generated jokes using a HateBERT-ToxiGen classifier and LLM-based ordinal classification (rating outputs as Not, Mild, or Severe Toxic) to analyze how toxic language acts as a shortcut to engagement and humor.
